# Wolt Discount Monitor

> Independent open-source dashboard for comparing Wolt promotions by city and estimated deal value.

Canonical: https://bl0ck154.github.io/wolt-discount-monitor/
Source: https://github.com/Bl0ck154/wolt-discount-monitor
Sitemap: https://bl0ck154.github.io/wolt-discount-monitor/sitemap.xml

The site exposes a static interactive dashboard plus generated city and country pages. Search-indexable city pages are published only while a stored snapshot is fresh. The project is not affiliated with Wolt. Always verify final prices and eligibility in Wolt.
